note: Android screens with no counterpart in the iOS probe baseline. They have no page contract (there is nothing to extract), so this file is their explicit registration; a screen that is neither here nor in a contract is an `unmapped-android-screen` failure. Each entry names the evidence that the baseline really lacks the page.

screens.reason: The baseline has no `struct SessionHistoryPage`: history is the ChatPage's `⋯` → 历史 entry in README §1, which the probe app never implemented as its own page. Android implemented it as a full screen, so there is no iOS structure to mirror.
screens.evidence: grep -rn 'struct SessionHistoryPage' examples/probe-app → no match (README §1 lists it as `later`)

screens.reason: The baseline has no `struct GoalDetailPage`: the goal is a bar in ChatPage (`GoalBar`) with sheet-based detail that the probe app never split into a page. Android implemented a standalone screen.
screens.evidence: grep -rn 'struct GoalDetailPage' examples/probe-app → no match (README §1 lists it as `later`)

screens.reason: iOS deleted its complete-Web surface (495da9b5 'Remove the app's complete-Web surface'): no `struct WebSurfacePage` is left, RootView.swift renders NativeShell unconditionally, and WebKit survives only as a 2-pt invisible anchor. Android still ships a full-screen Web host route, so there is no iOS page structure to mirror.
screens.evidence: git show --stat 495da9b5 (deletes examples/probe-app/PhoneDSHProbe/WebSurfacePage.swift); grep -rn 'struct WebSurfacePage' examples/probe-app -> no match; RootView.swift:9 `NativeShell()`

screens.reason: ToolsPage is the legacy 命令 view wrapper. `PDSHShellPage.kt` is the view the `pdsh-shell` contract now points at, and both share one reducer (ToolsScreenState / ShellLocalState / ShellUiEvent), so this composable is the only thing that no contract covers and no route calls — its single caller is ToolsPageTest.kt. It is registered here rather than deleted because the deletion has to happen on the Android side first: removing this entry while the composable still declares `public fun ToolsPage(` turns it straight into an unmapped-android-screen failure. Order: delete the composable and its test, then delete this entry.
screens.evidence: pdsh-shell.json android.file = .../PDSHShellPage.kt (match: composable); `grep -rn 'ToolsPage(' android/` finds only the declaration and its JVM test
